question: The National Youth Policy in India launched in February _______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 
 

• The **National Youth Policy (NYP)** in India was launched in **February 2014** by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

• The policy aims to empower the youth of India by addressing issues related to **education, employment, skill development, health, and leadership.** 

• The policy defines youth as individuals in the age group of **15 to 29 years**, which constitutes about **27.5% of the population**, according to the Census of 2011. 

• The National Youth Policy 2014 was created to replace the earlier version from **2003**, as it was considered outdated and less inclusive of the contemporary challenges faced by the youth. 

• The policy focuses on **five key priority areas**: education, employment and skill development, entrepreneurship, health and sports, and social values and community engagement.
